svg.title: Repository onboarding path
svg.desc: Five onboarding commands run in sequence to scaffold configuration, transpile context, record debt, and verify governance.

g.text: Target repository is initialized with declared profile and facets.
Canonical agent instructions in AGENTS.md are compiled.
Transpilation generates vendor instruction files and splices the text register.
HISS scanner sweeps the codebase for existing infractions.
Legacy infractions are snapshotted into .standards-baseline.json to prevent CI failure.
DevContainer configuration and reviewed source bundle companions are generated.
Configuration, Dockerfile, and exact source companions are prepared in .devcontainer/.
Audit checks manifest, lockfile, agent context, debt baseline, and DevContainer.
Every executed gate passes with zero files modified; repository is verified and governed.
